name: FogPlay
description: A tactile Phaser coin-flip table with secure local streak play and no wallet or GAS at risk. Wallet-funded GameFi remains paused while the public Neo N3 deployments are replaced with the reviewed contract artifact and revalidated.
description_zh: 精心设计的 Phaser 本地抛硬币连胜游戏，无需钱包，也不会使用 GAS。公开 Neo N3 部署与当前审计合约产物不一致，钱包 GameFi 将在重新部署并验证前保持关闭。

operation_panel.title: FogPlay
operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a side and flip locally on the designed Phaser table. Wallet-funded flips stay disabled until the deployment compatibility gate passes.

oracle.description: GameFi is disabled. Guest flips use secure local browser randomness; the retained Neo N3 design uses a fixed three-block beacon but is not advertised as proof-carrying VRF.

aa.description: AA rapid-play integration is planned but is not the live testnet flow

tee.description: The live product is single-player user-versus-system coin flip; PvP TEE duel mode is not enabled
